# Personal brand

Operating contour for Atabek Raimov's personal expert platform.

Authority: `docs/ssot/RAIMOV_WHOLE_PERSON_BRAND.md`. Signature platform: **RAIMOV WHOLE PERSON**. Position: clinical architect of complex dental cases using an evidence-aware whole-person / biopsychosocial lens within dental scope.

Store audience definitions, narrative pillars, channel roles, editorial programmes and measurement here. Facts and credentials remain in the evidence/public-profile contour; publishable copy remains in `docs/copy/raimov/`; runtime remains in `site-raimovdental/`.

## Active public platform

The public Whole-Person / Private Conversation release is active under `DEC-865`. The current production runtime and its medical/privacy boundaries remain authoritative until a later release is deployed and verified.

## Human Loop message for the next homepage

Owner-approved message base:

- `RAIMOV_HUMAN_LOOP_HOME_MESSAGE.md` — Whole Person explained through the feedback cycle between lifestyle, health, teeth/face/smile, self-perception, family, position, money, status and opportunities;
- `docs/copy/raimov/ru/public-site-v2/HOME.md` — complete homepage v2 copy;
- `docs/copy/raimov/ru/public-site-v2/HOME_VISUAL_BRIEF.md` — art direction, photography, diagrams, responsive and media-slot requirements.

Canonical wisdom:

> **Как вы живёте — становится видно. То, что видно, начинает влиять на то, как вы живёте дальше.**

Status, family and money/position may be expressed directly, but are never promised as medical outcomes. Dentistry may remove a dental limitation; it does not manufacture social status or a new personality.

## Previous copy package

`docs/copy/raimov/ru/public-site-v1/README.md` remains the long-form source package used for the first public release. It is not the authority for the new Human Loop homepage message where v2 explicitly differs.

Do not turn this contour into a clinic catalogue, lifestyle content plan, unsupported psychosomatic causation, covert cross-sell, reader humiliation or evidence-free authority claim.
